mechanism: Train-only behaviour-curvature-stratified Sinkhorn. A one-off CPU preprocessing over Stage-2 training sequences builds a symmetric sparse adjacent-pair count matrix A over the 24556 training items, keeps for each item its D highest-count neighbours (D = ceil(mean degree), ties by ascending id), and scores local-clustering cohesion coh_i = (1/deg_i) * sum_{j in N(i)} |N(i) cap N(j)| / sqrt(deg_i deg_j) in [0,1]; this is turned into a mid-rank empirical-CDF value rho_i in (0,1) (0.5 for items with no train edge) and cached as float32 [24556]. In Stage 2 the level-1 cost is the Poincare distance between the lifted encoder point x_i = exp_0^c(u_i) and the lifted raw codeword y_k = exp_0^c(q_k) at curvature c=1, minus a cohesion-vs-stratum offset beta*(1 - |rho_i - s_k|)*R_c, where s_k = sigmoid(a_k), a_k is initialised as logit((k+0.5)/K), and beta = m/R_c is the median over the batch of the level-1 distance at epoch 0 step 0 (measured once with beta=0) and then frozen. C is fed to the baseline's balanced Sinkhorn unchanged (same tau, same iteration count, row sums 1, column sums B/K); the hard level-1 index is the baseline's argmax over the plan P, and the baseline's straight-through selector p_i = one_hot(k1_i) + P_i - stop_grad(P_i) carries the gradient into a_k (through the offset), into the codewords (through d_c) and into the encoder (through d_c). Reconstruction and the residual recursion use the raw codewords q_k, never y_k; levels 2 and 3 remain Euclidean and untouched. No separate behaviour loss exists: the offset and the curvature meet in the same cost entry C and are the only input of the plan.

computations.name: adjacency_build
computations.definition: A = symmetric sparse [n_train,n_train] count matrix; for every training sequence (i_1,...,i_T) and every t, A[i_t,i_{t+1}] += 1 and A[i_{t+1},i_t] += 1
inputs: the Stage-2 train interaction sequences (train split only)
computations.note: outside the gradient; computed once, CPU, minutes; count = number of occurrences of the adjacent pair

computations.name: degree
computations.definition: deg_i = sum_j A[i,j]
computations.note: row count of A; deg_i = 0 for items with no train edge

computations.name: neighbourhood_size
computations.definition: D = ceil(mean_i deg_i) over the n_train = 24556 train items
computations.note: data-derived, computed once and fixed for the run

computations.name: neighbourhood
computations.definition: N(i) = the D entries of row i of A with the largest counts, ties broken by ascending item id
computations.output: N(i), index set of size <= D per item
computations.note: top-D by count, deterministic tie-break

computations.name: cohesion_similarity
computations.definition: sim_ij = |N(i) cap N(j)| / sqrt(deg_i * deg_j)
computations.note: only defined for pairs joined by a train edge

computations.name: cohesion
computations.definition: coh_i = (1/deg_i) * sum_{j in N(i)} sim_ij
computations.note: local triangle-closure curvature proxy

computations.name: cohesion_rank
computations.definition: rho_i = ( #{j : coh_j < coh_i} + 0.5 * #{j : coh_j = coh_i, j < i} ) / (n_train - 1); rho_i = 0.5 for items with no train edge
computations.note: mid-rank empirical CDF with uniform marginal; cached once, frozen for all 3000 epochs

computations.name: rho_lookup
computations.definition: rho_i = RHO[i] for the batch items
computations.note: constant w.r.t. every model parameter

computations.name: exp_lift_encoder
computations.definition: x_i = exp_0^c(u_i) = tanhc(sqrt(c)||u_i||) * u_i, with tanhc(0)=1; c = 1
computations.note: origin form of the contract's exp, zero-norm limit taken through tanhc, no epsilon guard

computations.name: exp_lift_codes
computations.definition: y_k = exp_0^c(q_k) = tanhc(sqrt(c)||q_k||) * q_k, with tanhc(0)=1; c = 1
computations.note: the lifted code is used for the cost only; never for reconstruction

computations.name: poincare_distance
computations.definition: d_c(x_i,y_k) = (2/sqrt(c)) * artanh( clip( sqrt(c) * || (-x_i) (+)c y_k ||, 1-eps ) ), with (-x)(+)c y as in the contract (curvature kappa = -c)
computations.note: contract operator, no local variant; c=0 branch is d_0 = 2||x-y||

computations.name: stratum_logit_init
computations.note: initial value of a learnable parameter, crisp quantile stratification at step 0

computations.name: stratum_value
computations.definition: s_k = sigmoid(a_k) = 1 / (1 + exp(-a_k))
computations.note: the continuous stratum coordinate matched against rho_i

computations.name: beta_freeze
computations.definition: m = median_i d_c(exp_0^c(u_i), exp_0^c(q_{k1(i)})) measured once at epoch 0 step 0 with beta = 0; beta = m / R_c; then frozen (no gradient, no update)
computations.note: the only place the baseline cost scale is calibrated; afterwards it is a constant

computations.name: behaviour_offset
computations.definition: off_ik = - beta * (1 - |rho_i - s_k|) * R_c
computations.note: in [-beta*R_c, 0]; zero exactly when rho_i = s_k; differentiable in a_k with subgradient -beta*R_c*s_k*(1-s_k)*sign(rho_i - s_k)

computations.name: level1_cost
computations.definition: C_ik = d_c(exp_0^c(u_i), exp_0^c(q_k)) - beta * (1 - |rho_i - s_k|) * R_c
computations.note: the single meeting point of behaviour and curvature; the only input of the plan

computations.name: sinkhorn_kernel
computations.definition: Ktilde_ik = exp(-C_ik / tau)
computations.note: tau unchanged from the baseline

computations.name: balanced_sinkhorn_plan
computations.definition: (u,v) = Sinkhorn_it(Ktilde) with row sums 1 and column sums B/K; P = diag(u) Ktilde diag(v)
computations.output: P [B,K], rows sum to 1, columns sum to B/K
computations.note: the baseline's operator, called unchanged; same tau, same iteration count

computations.name: hard_assignment
computations.definition: k1_i = argmax_k P_ik
computations.note: discrete decision; no gradient; it selects the raw codeword

computations.name: straight_through_selector
computations.definition: p_i = one_hot(k1_i) + P_i - stop_grad(P_i)
computations.note: the baseline's STE: identity in the backward, x + (x_q - x).detach()

computations.name: level1_reconstruction
computations.definition: e1_i = q_{k1_i} (a row gather of the raw codeword); r2_i = u_i - e1_i
computations.note: raw q_k, never the lifted y_k; gradient scatter-adds into row k1 of q and flows into u

computations.name: residual_recursion_levels_2_3
computations.definition: levels 2 and 3 exactly as in the baseline: Euclidean codes, Euclidean distances, Euclidean Sinkhorn/argmax, reconstruction on r2
computations.note: untouched by this mechanism; no curvature, no behaviour offset

computations.name: encoder_gradient_path
computations.definition: dL/du_i = sum_k (dL/dC_ik) * dC_ik/du_i, with dL/dC entering through the STE plan p and C_ik depending on u_i only through d_c(exp_0^c(u_i), y_k); the reconstruction path adds dL/de1_i
computations.note: exactly the baseline's STE scale: one unit of plan weight per item, no rescaling

computations.name: strata_gradient_path
computations.definition: dL/da_k = sum_i (dL/dC_ik) * (-beta*R_c) * s_k*(1-s_k)*sign(rho_i - s_k)
computations.note: reaches a_k only through P -> C -> |rho_i - s_k|; if the baseline detaches P, a_k stays at its quantile init (documented fallback, mechanism unchanged)

computations.name: switch_behaviour_off
computations.definition: off_ik := 0, i.e. C_ik = d_c(exp_0^c(u_i), exp_0^c(q_k))
computations.note: Poincare metric, strata a_k and the balanced Sinkhorn stay in the code path; plain hyperbolic-cost balanced quantization, no behaviour information; correct in code, not trained this round

computations.name: switch_geometry_off
computations.definition: c := 0, so C_ik = 2*||u_i - q_k|| + beta*(1 - |rho_i - s_k|)*R_c with the same frozen R_c scale constant, and a_k still logit((k+0.5)/K)
computations.note: the c->0 limit of the contract evaluated without the exp lift; same-capacity Euclidean control, a separate arm in its own round

inputs: u, the encoder output of the batch, [B,64]
rho, per-item cohesion rank of the batch items, [B], from the cached float32 [24556] table
the frozen rho table RHO, float32 [24556]
the Stage-2 train interaction sequences (preprocessing only)
constants c = 1, R_c = 1, and tau plus the Sinkhorn iteration count inherited from the baseline
outputs: P, the balanced plan from the baseline Sinkhorn, [B,K]
k1, the hard level-1 index, [B] int64
rho, the cached float32 [24556] preprocessing output
the frozen SID table exported for Stage 3
parameters: a, the stratum logits, [K] = [256], trainable, initialised logit((k+0.5)/K)
beta, scalar, frozen after epoch 0 step 0, not trainable
rho, [24556] and its batch slice [B], constant, not trainable
c = 1, constant (0 under the geometry switch)
tau and the Sinkhorn iteration count, inherited constants
the level-2 and level-3 codebooks, trained exactly as in the baseline
switches: --behaviour_off: sets the offset term to exactly 0, C_ik = d_c(exp_0^c(u_i), exp_0^c(q_k)) with the second term identically zero; the Poincare metric, the stratum parameters a_k and the balanced Sinkhorn assignment stay in the code path, so the arm is plain hyperbolic-cost balanced quantization with no behaviour information; it exists and is correct in code, and no such arm is trained this round

--geometry_off: sets c = 0, so the cost becomes the Euclidean c->0 limit C_ik = 2*||u_i - q_k|| (evaluated without the exp lift) with the behaviour offset beta*(1 - |rho_i - s_k|)*R_c still added at the same frozen R_c scale constant, and a_k still initialised as logit((k+0.5)/K) and still used; this is the same-capacity Euclidean control, a separate arm in its own round rather than an ablation of this round
excluded: any recomputation of rho from the model or from Stage-2/Stage-3 statistics: rho is fixed by the train-only graph and frozen for the whole run
any gradient through the graph side (A, deg, D, N(i), sim, coh, rho): all detached, all offline
curvature on levels 2 and 3: they stay Euclidean and untouched, so no d_c, no exp lift and no stratum offset is applied there
a Frechet mean or a barycentre anywhere: it is never used by this mechanism, and a coordinate average would not be one under the contract

any redefinition of the contract's operators (clamps, epsilon guards, unit-ball radius, a second definition of distance): forbidden by the geometry contract, and this mechanism uses the module as delivered
an additional loss term for the behaviour signal or for the strata: the coupling is exclusively through C -> P -> k1
training of the two ablation arms in this round: documented and correct in code, they are separate rounds
Stage-3 training itself: this mechanism only exports the frozen SID table

continuous_surface.name: the differentiable level-1 cost entry C_ik
continuous_surface.note: x is u_i (tangent coordinates), y is q_k; the exp_0^c lift is inside the statements; c = 0 short-circuits to D = 2*sqrt((x0-y0)**2 + (x1-y1)**2)
